_comment: Expected `next build` render mode for every route, asserted by scripts/assert-route-classification.mjs after a build. Guards the conversion-track payoff (3.0.4.8+3.0.4.9): a route must not silently regress to a more dynamic mode. Modes: 'static' = ○ (fully prerendered), 'partial' = ◐ (partial prerender — static shell + request-time <Suspense> holes), 'dynamic' = ƒ (server-rendered per request). New routes must be added here or the check fails. If a change is intentional, update this file in the same commit. Choosing a mode (priority, weighed against the page's purpose): prefer 'static' first; if the page needs request-time data, isolate it in a <Suspense> hole so the shell still prerenders ('partial'); use 'dynamic' only when the whole screen is genuinely per-request (/api/* handlers, mutations, per-request auth/DB). Counterweight — never force a more-static mode than the page honestly supports; a truly full-screen dynamic surface should be dynamic, not contorted into a fake shell.

_reasons./: Transient auth_error query param renders in a Suspense dynamic hole; hero + tiles are static.
_reasons./atlas: Site-framed landing: PageHead is the static shell while the administrator check and catalogue stream from a request-time hole; a selected map covers that chrome with the full-viewport canvas.
_reasons./opengraph-image: Deploy-static: the social-card fonts are read once at module scope with top-level await (the documented Cache Components pattern for bundled request-independent assets), so the handler's render path performs no IO and the build prerenders the PNG deterministically. Awaiting the file reads inside the handler made this route's mode flap between static and dynamic across identical builds.
_reasons./icon.svg: The tab icon is a literal src/app/icon.svg file, not a generated handler, so the metadata route prerenders to a static asset with no request-time input. The sibling src/app/favicon.ico is the legacy fallback and is filtered out of this check by assert-route-classification.mjs.
_reasons./sites: The hourly cached priced catalogue supplies the prerendered page head and filter chrome; the saved-view cookie selects the streamed result branch, with the table's searchParams-driven sort nested inside it, while client in-view refresh keeps price figures current.
_reasons./sites/[id]: Per-site detail (params + DB + live prices) streams from a dynamic hole.
_reasons./sites/[id]/opengraph-image-38dcjp: Parameterized metadata-image handler; Next 16 classifies it as dynamic while its only data dependency remains the hourly cached, price-tagged site detail and the file convention caches the response by default. The -38dcjp suffix is Next's metadata-route disambiguator, added once this handler moved under the (site) route group: getMetadataRouteSuffix appends djb2Hash(parentPathname) base36 whenever a parent segment is a group or parallel segment, so it is derived from the path alone and changes only if the handler moves again.
_reasons./admin: Per-user: the session-gated single-page dashboard (headline metrics, system health, ESI ops, traffic, users) is a request-time dynamic hole; visx charts are client-only islands inside it.
_reasons./admin/access: Per-user: session-gated admin-role management + audit is a request-time dynamic hole.
_reasons./admin/access/[userId]: Per-user: session-gated admin user detail (a user's linked characters + sessions; force-unlink / reassign / force-logout) is a request-time dynamic hole; the page container prerenders.
_reasons./admin/statics: Per-user: the admin gate and pending statics snapshot read are isolated in a request-time Suspense hole; the operator page container prerenders.
_reasons./api/admin/wh-statics: Dynamic admin form mutation: same-origin refresh, promote, or reject action followed by a 303 redirect.
_reasons./api/cron/refresh-wh-statics: Dynamic weekly cron: conditional community-feed probe and lock-guarded pending snapshot write.
_reasons./preview/primitives: Admin-gated primitive reference: the page chrome prerenders and the session check plus rendered interactive sheet stream from a request-time Suspense hole.
_reasons./preview/widgets: Widget isolation page: SDE-backed site identifier is cached into the prerender and widgets load their public detail endpoint after mount; partial because the shared header's Tranquility chip is a request-time io() hole.
_reasons./characters: Per-user: PageHead stays in the static shell; the session-gated character-management list (link / switch active / unlink) is a request-time dynamic hole with a content-shaped skeleton.
_reasons./industry: Industry dashboard — static shell of the header, typed hint, and the section-grid skeleton; the session + linked-character read (plus the corp gates) is ONE request-time dynamic hole feeding the client section grid, which ranks populated sections above empty ones and resolves everything client-side: recents (localStorage), build templates (/api/account/saved-plans), the personal + corp job boards (/api/account/industry-jobs, /api/account/corp-industry-jobs — Neon stale-gated on-view reads; each job's live ready + countdown derives client-side from its absolute end_date). The header's used/total slot readout is its own small hole, fetching capacity from /api/account/industry-slots client-side.
_reasons./industry/templates: Build-templates library — page body is a client island fetching /api/account/saved-plans on mount (anonymous visitors settle to a sign-in hint); load navigates to /industry/[id]?plan=, and rename/favorite/delete reuse the saved-plans endpoints. Partial because the shared header's Tranquility chip is a request-time io() hole.
_reasons./industry/[id]: Per-blueprint planner ([id] param + cached structure/prices) streams from a dynamic hole, which also reads the build-character preference cookie; page chrome is the static shell.
_reasons./skills: Per-user: the session-gated linked-character read (names, portraits, scope health) is a request-time dynamic hole; the page container is the static shell, and the queue data itself is fetched client-side from /api/account/skills (a Neon stale-gated on-view read; the live countdown derives client-side from each entry's absolute finish_date) — no server render-time data.
_reasons./jobs: Per-user: the session-gated linked-character read (names, portraits, scope health) is a request-time dynamic hole; the page container is the static shell, and the personal job boards are fetched client-side from /api/account/industry-jobs and the corporation jobs from /api/account/corp-industry-jobs (both Neon stale-gated on-view reads; each job's live ready + countdown derives client-side from its absolute end_date) — no server render-time data.
_reasons./structures: Per-user: PageHead stays in the static shell; the session-gated structure builder (saved custom-structures + cached SDE picker options) is a request-time dynamic hole with a content-shaped skeleton. The builder + saved list are a client island calling the /api/account/custom-structures CRUD.
_reasons./settings: Per-user: PageHead stays in the static shell; the session-gated account-settings content (registry-resolved controls + Station_Manager corp-sharing read) is a request-time dynamic hole with a content-shaped skeleton.
_reasons./changelog: The newest changelog master is a cached file read + parse, and the shared rail's active-version highlight is isolated in Suspense around usePathname. Partial because the shared header's Tranquility chip is a request-time io() hole.
_reasons./changelog/[slug]: Older changelog masters are prerendered from generateStaticParams and the same cached parse, but partial: the shared rail's active-version highlight reads usePathname in Suspense, and the master body awaits params inside its own Suspense hole so soft navigations between masters stay instant. Unknown and newest-master aliases render the not-found boundary as a streamed 200 with injected noindex (the documented Cache Components soft-404 contract).
_reasons./devlog: The dev log (content/devlog/) is a cached file read + parse; the file-browser rail's active-document highlight is a usePathname read isolated in Suspense. Partial because the shared header's Tranquility chip is a request-time io() hole.
_reasons./devlog/[slug]: Prerendered per slug (generateStaticParams) from the same cached parse, but partial: the shared layout's active-document highlight reads usePathname in Suspense, and the document body awaits params inside its own Suspense hole so soft navigations between slugs stay instant. Cache Components disallows dynamicParams, so an unknown slug renders the not-found boundary as a streamed 200 with injected noindex.
_reasons./api/industry/blueprints: Blueprint search index is deploy-static SDE data (cached 'max', SDE-tag revalidated), so the handler prerenders to a static JSON asset — no per-request input.
_reasons./api/industry/systems: Universe system search index (every persistent solar system — K-space, Pochven, J-space) is deploy-static SDE data (cached 'max', SDE-tag revalidated), so the handler prerenders to a static JSON asset — no per-request input. Matched client-side by the systems search source (the build-location pickers + the structure-pin control).
_reasons./api/universe/assets: Dynamic no-store manifest: connection() defers the SDE-version read to request time so each map session discovers the current immutable asset version.
_reasons./api/universe/assets/[version]/systems: Dynamic version-addressed JSON handler: the SDE-tag-cached payload gates its own version and successful responses are immutable.
_reasons./api/universe/assets/[version]/adjacency: Dynamic version-addressed JSON handler: the SDE-tag-cached payload gates its own version and successful responses are immutable.
_reasons./api/universe/assets/[version]/wormholes: Dynamic version-addressed JSON handler: the SDE-tag-cached payload gates its own version and successful responses are immutable.
_reasons./api/universe/statics/[systemId]: Dynamic path-addressed JSON handler over the shared tag-cached promoted wormhole statics dataset; valid unknown systems return an empty picker list.
_reasons.dynamic /api/*: Route handlers — per-request by nature (auth, mutations, DB queries, crons, external calls). Justified dynamic.
_reasons./api/maps/jump: Dynamic authenticated mutation route: doorbell/confirm/typed-hole jump-resolver entries verify the session user per request, read Convex evidence + Neon geography, and dispatch the transactional authoring door — genuinely per-request.
_reasons./api/maps/access: Dynamic authenticated mutation route: each request requires map-admin authority, commits one Neon grant upsert or revoke, and reconverges the complete one-way Convex access projection.
_reasons./api/maps/delete: Dynamic authenticated mutation route: each request atomically requires active-map admin authority, starts the durable undo window, and tears down the live access projection.
_reasons./api/maps/restore: Dynamic authenticated mutation route: each request atomically requires archived-map admin authority inside grace and rebuilds the one-way access projection.
_reasons./api/maps/purge-now: Dynamic authenticated creator-only mutation route: marks an archived map for the next scheduled purge without deleting chain data directly.
_reasons./api/cron/purge-maps: Dynamic daily cron: lock-guarded bounded Neon eligibility scan, resumable Convex map-chain purge, then durable tombstone.
_reasons./api/maps/create: Dynamic authenticated mutation route: each request rate-limits one user, commits one Neon map-plus-grants transaction, and drives the one-way Convex access projection.
_reasons./api/maps/search-characters: Dynamic authenticated read route: each request selects an owned linked token for scoped ESI typeahead or uses the public exact-name fallback when no scoped token exists.
_reasons./api/maps/signature-elimination: Dynamic authenticated mutation route: each acting-user trigger reads current Convex map evidence and promoted Neon statics, runs the pure eliminator, and dispatches one transactional assumed-tier write batch.
_reasons./api/sync-leave: Dynamic authenticated mutation: the Atlas pagehide beacon retires one tab's location sync subject per request.
